_comment: Budget for `npm run test:perf`. `gates` fails the build; `reference` is printed for a human and does not. The gated metric is a count (`jsdomFileCount`), so it is machine-independent: it caps the subset of files that each pay ~106ms of jsdom construction (ADR: isolated/node 40ms vs isolated/jsdom 147ms per file, environment 81% of the jsdom figure). `fileCount` was demoted from `gates` to `reference` on 2026-10-18: a total prices every file the same and ratcheted continuously (930 -> 1060 -> 1062 -> 1093), so only the fixed-cost driver gates now; the total is still printed as an advisory. See dev-docs/ADR/2026-09-26-test-suite-execution-time-contract.md (R4 and the 2026-10-18 entry). The JSON reporter cannot measure fixed cost — both time columns cover the test phase only — so wall is the sole figure that includes it and wall is machine- and worker-count-dependent (76.9s at 6 workers, 184s at 3, 303s at 2 on one 8-core box). Raising a gate requires an ADR note recording the trajectory and the cause, because a bare raise only resets the clock.
